qa_pair.question: Inspect the prepared desktop workbook and read its populated column. Which cell is calculated from the two numeric inputs? Return its address only.
Inspect the prepared desktop workbook and read the formula and value in its last populated row. Return the numeric value.
Inspect the prepared desktop workbook and determine the rectangular used range covering the inputs and result. Return the range in A1 notation.
Read the prepared desktop workbook's calculated cell both as formula and as value, then inspect its formula dependencies. Return the formula text including the leading equals sign.
Inspect the workbook saved by the prepared headless scenario, then read the formula cell in its populated column. Return its computed value.
Inspect the workbook saved by the prepared headless scenario and read its input rows and calculated row. Which cell references the two inputs? Return its address.
Inspect both prepared desktop and headless workbooks, locate each calculated result and read its value. What is the difference, headless minus desktop?
Inspect both prepared workbooks and read the two numeric inputs in each. Return the largest input value across both workbooks.
Inspect both prepared workbooks and read their formula cells. Are their formulas identical when ignoring which column they refer to? Return True or False.

Inspect the prepared headless workbook and read its numeric input rows. If the larger input were removed, what value would the current sum formula give? Answer by reasoning from read-only data, without editing.
